model.name: openai/gpt-6-luna
model.about: OpenAI: GPT-6 Luna, through OpenRouter at $0.1 in and $0.5 out per million tokens.

answers.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR IS TRUE
  AND IS_ACTV IS TRUE;

SELECT
    f.BR_K AS branch_key,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY f.BR_K
ORDER BY f.BR_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
  ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT
    COALESCE(c.DSPLY_NM, 'Unknown') AS complaint_category,
    COUNT(*) AS complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS c
    ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = f.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY COALESCE(c.DSPLY_NM, 'Unknown')
ORDER BY complaint_category;

SELECT
    ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(DISTINCT ACCT_NBR_HSH) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT
WHERE OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND IS_CURR IS TRUE
GROUP BY ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT
    f.CCY_CD1 AS currency_code,
    AVG(f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT) AS average_closing_balance,
    COUNT(*) AS account_balance_row_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
GROUP BY f.CCY_CD1
ORDER BY f.CCY_CD1;

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN AS t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
);

SELECT
    100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE PMT_STS_CD1 = 'DECLINED')
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS declined_authorization_percentage
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_AUTH
WHERE ATHRZ_AT >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-01-01 00:00:00+00'
  AND ATHRZ_AT <  TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00';

SELECT
    c.DSPLY_NM AS complaint_category_name,
    COUNT(*) AS escalated_complaint_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CMPLT AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_CMPLT_CTG AS c
    ON c.CMPLT_CTG_K = f.CMPLT_CTG_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
  AND f.IS_ESCLT IS TRUE
GROUP BY c.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY c.DSPLY_NM;

WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.cust_k
    FROM bank_dwh.f_wr_trf AS w
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
      ON d.dt_k = w.bus_dt_k
    WHERE d.cal_dt >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.cal_dt < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.cust_k
    FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn AS a
    JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
      ON d.dt_k = a.bus_dt_k
    WHERE d.cal_dt >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.cal_dt < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM wire_customers AS w
JOIN atm_customers AS a
  ON a.cust_k = w.cust_k;
DROP TABLE bank_dwh.F_CMPLT;

SELECT
    CUST_K,
    BUS_ID,
    DSPLY_NM,
    CTY_NM,
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS current_customer_segment,
    'AFFLUENT'::VARCHAR(50) AS proposed_customer_segment
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca'
  AND IS_CURR IS TRUE;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.is_wknd IS TRUE) AS weekend_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.is_wknd IS FALSE) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn AS t
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
    ON t.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_dt >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.cal_dt < DATE '2026-01-01';

WITH versioned_customers AS (
    SELECT
        BUS_ID,
        IS_CURR,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        LAG(CUST_SGMNT_CD1) OVER (
            PARTITION BY BUS_ID
            ORDER BY VRSN_NBR
        ) AS previous_segment
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM versioned_customers
WHERE IS_CURR IS TRUE
  AND CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM previous_segment;

WITH dispute_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS d
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
      ON dt.DT_K = d.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
      ON dt.DT_K = w.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM dispute_customers AS d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM wire_customers AS w
    WHERE w.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
);

WITH customers_valid_on_date AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
      AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2023-06-30')
)
SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM customers_valid_on_date
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR IS TRUE
  AND IS_ACTV IS TRUE;

SELECT
    b.BR_K,
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS t
JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS b
    ON t.BR_K = b.BR_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON t.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY b.DSPLY_NM, b.BR_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
  ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DFLT_FLG IS TRUE;

SELECT
    acct_typ_cd1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.d_acct
WHERE is_curr IS TRUE
  AND opnd_dt >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND opnd_dt < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY acct_typ_cd1
ORDER BY acct_typ_cd1;

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR IS TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN AS t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
);

WITH wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON d.DT_K = w.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
atm_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT a.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS a
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON d.DT_K = a.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM wire_customers AS w
JOIN atm_customers AS a
  ON a.CUST_K = w.CUST_K;

SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE d.is_wknd) AS weekend_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT d.is_wknd) AS weekday_count
FROM bank_dwh.f_atm_txn AS t
JOIN bank_dwh.d_dt AS d
  ON t.bus_dt_k = d.dt_k
WHERE d.cal_dt >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.cal_dt < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT jun.ACCT_K) AS account_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS jun
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS jun_dt
  ON jun.BUS_DT_K = jun_dt.DT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS dec
  ON dec.ACCT_K = jun.ACCT_K
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dec_dt
  ON dec.BUS_DT_K = dec_dt.DT_K
WHERE jun_dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30'
  AND dec_dt.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31'
  AND jun.CLSNG_BAL_AMT > 0
  AND dec.CLSNG_BAL_AMT < jun.CLSNG_BAL_AMT * 0.90;

WITH current_customers AS (
    SELECT BUS_ID, VRSN_NBR, CUST_SGMNT_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR IS TRUE
), current_vs_previous AS (
    SELECT
        c.BUS_ID,
        c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS current_segment,
        p.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS previous_segment
    FROM current_customers AS c
    JOIN LATERAL (
        SELECT d.CUST_SGMNT_CD1
        FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS d
        WHERE d.BUS_ID = c.BUS_ID
          AND d.VRSN_NBR < c.VRSN_NBR
        ORDER BY d.VRSN_NBR DESC
        LIMIT 1
    ) AS p ON TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM current_vs_previous
WHERE current_segment IS DISTINCT FROM previous_segment;

WITH dispute_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS d
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
      ON dt.DT_K = d.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
      ON dt.DT_K = w.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM dispute_customers AS d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM wire_customers AS w
    WHERE w.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
);

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(DISTINCT BUS_ID) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE EFF_FRM_DT <= DATE '2023-06-30'
  AND (EFF_TO_DT IS NULL OR EFF_TO_DT >= DATE '2023-06-30')
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CUST_K) AS active_customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR IS TRUE
  AND IS_ACTV IS TRUE;

SELECT
    b.BR_K,
    b.DSPLY_NM AS branch_name,
    COUNT(*) AS atm_transaction_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_ATM_TXN AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
    ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
LEFT JOIN bank_dwh.D_BR AS b
    ON f.BR_K = b.BR_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY b.BR_K, b.DSPLY_NM
ORDER BY branch_name, b.BR_K;

SELECT COUNT(*) AS card_dispute_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS d
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
  ON d.BUS_DT_K = dt.DT_K
WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT f.CUST_K) AS defaulted_client_count
FROM bank_dwh.F_LN_DLQ_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON d.DT_K = f.BUS_DT_K
WHERE d.CAL_DT = DATE '2025-08-31'
  AND f.DFLT_FLG IS TRUE;

SELECT
    a.ACCT_TYP_CD1 AS account_type_code,
    COUNT(*) AS accounts_opened
FROM bank_dwh.D_ACCT AS a
WHERE a.IS_CURR = TRUE
  AND a.OPND_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
  AND a.OPND_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1
ORDER BY a.ACCT_TYP_CD1;

SELECT AVG(f.MID_RT) AS avg_mid_rate
FROM bank_dwh.F_FX_RT_D AS f
JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
  ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
WHERE f.CCY_CD1 = 'USD'
  AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-12-01'
  AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01';

SELECT
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS customer_segment,
    COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR IS TRUE
GROUP BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1
ORDER BY CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.CUST_K) AS customer_count
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_TXN AS t
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON d.DT_K = t.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE t.CUST_K = c.CUST_K
      AND d.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND d.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
);

SELECT DSPLY_NM AS branch_name
FROM bank_dwh.D_BR;

SELECT
    CUST_K,
    BUS_ID,
    DSPLY_NM,
    CTY_NM,
    CUST_SGMNT_CD1 AS current_customer_segment,
    'AFFLUENT' AS proposed_customer_segment
FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
WHERE IS_CURR IS TRUE
  AND CTY_NM = 'Cluj-Napoca';

WITH balances AS (
    SELECT
        f.ACCT_K,
        d.CAL_DT,
        f.CLSNG_BAL_AMT
    FROM bank_dwh.F_ACCT_BAL_D AS f
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS d
      ON f.BUS_DT_K = d.DT_K
    WHERE d.CAL_DT IN (DATE '2025-06-30', DATE '2025-12-31')
), account_comparison AS (
    SELECT
        ACCT_K,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_DT = DATE '2025-06-30' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS june_closing_balance,
        MAX(CASE WHEN CAL_DT = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN CLSNG_BAL_AMT END) AS december_closing_balance
    FROM balances
    GROUP BY ACCT_K
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count
FROM account_comparison
WHERE june_closing_balance > 0
  AND december_closing_balance < june_closing_balance * 0.90;

WITH current_customers AS (
    SELECT
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR = TRUE
),
previous_versions AS (
    SELECT
        BUS_ID,
        CUST_SGMNT_CD1,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY BUS_ID
            ORDER BY VRSN_NBR DESC
        ) AS version_rank
    FROM bank_dwh.D_CUST
    WHERE IS_CURR IS DISTINCT FROM TRUE
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM current_customers AS c
JOIN previous_versions AS p
    ON p.BUS_ID = c.BUS_ID
   AND p.version_rank = 1
WHERE c.CUST_SGMNT_CD1 IS DISTINCT FROM p.CUST_SGMNT_CD1;

WITH disputing_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_CD_DSPT AS d
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
      ON dt.DT_K = d.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
wire_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT w.CUST_K
    FROM bank_dwh.F_WR_TRF AS w
    JOIN bank_dwh.D_DT AS dt
      ON dt.DT_K = w.BUS_DT_K
    WHERE dt.CAL_DT >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND dt.CAL_DT < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(*) AS distinct_customer_count
FROM disputing_customers AS d
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM wire_customers AS w
    WHERE w.CUST_K = d.CUST_K
);
